name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  code_quality:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]

      - name: Lockfile validation
        run: |
          if [ -f poetry.lock ]; then
            poetry check
          else
            echo "No lockfile found, skipping lockfile validation."
          fi

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Ruff check
        run: ruff check .

      - name: Ruff format check
        run: ruff format --check .

  unit_tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            --maxfail=1 \
            --disable-warnings \
            --ignore=tests/unit/api \
            --ignore=tests/unit/test_rate_limiting_realistic.py \
            --ignore=tests/unit/test_embedding_rate_limiting_realistic.py \
            tests/unit

  cli_tests:
    name: CLI Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: unit_tests
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]

      - name: Run CLI tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            --maxfail=1 \
            --disable-warnings \
            tests/unit/cli

  telemetry_tests:
    name: Telemetry Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: cli_tests
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]

      - name: Run telemetry tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            --maxfail=1 \
            --disable-warnings \
            tests/unit/telemetry
